title: Taylor remainder bound of arbitrary order
statement:
Let $m\ge0$ be an integer, let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $(m+1)$ times continuously differentiable, and suppose $C\in\mathbb R$ satisfies $|\psi^{(m+1)}(t)|\le C$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$,
\[\left|\psi(a+b)-\sum_{j=0}^{m}\frac{\psi^{(j)}(a)}{j!}b^j\right|\le\frac{C}{(m+1)!}|b|^{m+1}.\]
hypotheses_covered: $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is $(m+1)$ times continuously differentiable.
